title: Portal
provenance: verified locally on Apple Silicon (M1 Pro), engine sikarugir-10.0_6, Highball 0.7.13, 2026-08-28
notes: Works at ~96 fps under DXVK with HDR off — and the Portal recipe turns it off for you (one button on the game's page in Highball). Same MoltenVK HDR bug and same fix as Portal 2: without mat_hdr_level 0 map loads die on this engine; with it the opening vault renders flawlessly with a clean device log. Apply the Portal fix after installing, keep the bottle on DXVK.

knownIssues.symptom: Much slower than recorded on some setups: about 17 fps in the first chamber.
knownIssues.cause: not established; the same shape as Portal 2's entry, measured 2026-09-10 on engine r2 with the GPU idle at 4 ms inside a 57 ms frame. Measured identically on r1, so the engine is not the variable.
knownIssues.fix: none known. Try DXVK async off, which is what the Portal 2 recipe's verified run used.
